description: This file defines the EventTableConfig class, which extends EntityTableConfig to configure and manage event table display, filtering, and actions within the Thingsboard UI. It includes methods for updating columns, handling filters, showing content, and managing event types.

classes.name: EventTableConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for event table, managing columns, filters, actions, and event types in the Thingsboard UI.

methods.name: clearEvents
methods.description: Clears events after user confirmation, resets table page, and updates data.

methods.name: fetchEvents
methods.description: Fetches filtered events from the EventService based on current filters and entity.

methods.name: updateColumns
methods.description: Updates table columns dynamically based on the current event type.

methods.name: updateCellAction
methods.description: Updates cell action descriptors based on the event type and debug mode.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Displays detailed content in a dialog, optionally sorting JSON keys.

methods.name: updateFilterColumns
methods.description: Configures filter columns based on the current event type.

methods.name: clearFiter
methods.description: Clears current filters and refreshes data.

methods.name: editEventFilter
methods.description: Opens an overlay panel to edit event filters, updating filters on close.
